item.title: movichhotels.com: 68. The gap: measurement.
item.description:
Every page has a title, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But tracking starts before the visitor chooses.
The lesson for every team: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

item.title: bbva.com.co: 68. The gap: the https redirect.
item.description:
Every page has a title, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But plain http serves the site without redirecting.
The lesson for every team: Redirect every http request to https with one permanent 301, then add HSTS.

item.title: ILO: secure and fast, but no entity markup.
item.description:
security.txt is published, HSTS covers subdomains, and DMARC rejects spoofed mail. But no page analyzed carries JSON-LD, so the Facebook, LinkedIn and YouTube profiles it links are never tied to the ILO.
The lesson for every team: Add Organization markup with url, logo and sameAs so AI answers name you right.
